purpose: Operational request matrix for obtaining the six real external/production evidence classes required by the existing E2I architectural-stop contract. This matrix does not constitute any evidence result, legal opinion, professional approval, verifier trust decision, release authorization, deployment authorization, or go-live authorization.

evidenceRequests.requestedVerifierRole: Independent canonical-source custodian or evidence verifier authorized for canonical-source comparison
scopeQuestions: Does the supplied external canonical source artifact hash exactly match the repository-pinned expected SHA-256?
Is the source artifact provenance independently documented and attributable to the intended canonical source?
Is the verification tied to the exact E2H closeout packet, release candidate, source commit, artifact hash, environment reference, and environment configuration hash?
evidenceRequests.minimumDeliverable: Signed E2I evidence record with VERIFIED, REJECTED, or INCONCLUSIVE result, evidence artifact SHA-256, source reference, verification timestamp, scope reference, verifier identity, and RSA-SHA256 signature.

evidenceRequests.requestedVerifierRole: Independent Saudi-qualified legal reviewer with authority to assess the platform operating model
scopeQuestions: Does the proposed operating mode remain outside licensed real-estate brokerage, licensed real-estate consultation/analysis, and licensed valuation activities, or does any platform function require a relevant Saudi license?

Do recommendations, written outputs, public-facing analyses, user workflows, or commercial claims cause the service to fall within regulated real-estate services under the Real Estate General Authority framework?
Does any output constitute valuation practice that requires an accredited valuer or a licensed valuation establishment?
What mandatory product, workflow, contracting, disclosure, or claim restrictions are required before production use?
evidenceRequests.minimumDeliverable: Signed legal review evidence artifact identifying reviewed functions, applicable rules, assumptions, required restrictions, unresolved issues, and final VERIFIED/REJECTED/INCONCLUSIVE result for the exact release scope.

scopeQuestions: What personal data is processed by each production workflow and for what purpose and legal basis?

Are notices, consent where applicable, data-subject rights, retention, deletion, access controls, processor arrangements, breach handling, and records of processing adequate for the exact production scope?
Are any cross-border transfers, cloud-processing arrangements, logs, analytics, uploaded documents, or generated reports subject to additional controls?
Do production configuration and operational procedures implement the required controls rather than merely documenting them?
evidenceRequests.minimumDeliverable: Signed PDPL/data-governance review evidence artifact with system scope, data-flow assumptions, control findings, required remediation, residual risks, and VERIFIED/REJECTED/INCONCLUSIVE result.

publicSourceRefs.title: Implementing Regulations of the Personal Data Protection Law

evidenceRequests.requestedVerifierRole: Independent Saudi valuation/professional-standards reviewer competent in the relevant real-estate scope
scopeQuestions: Which platform outputs, calculations, labels, reports, and workflows could reasonably be understood as valuation, appraisal, professional valuation advice, or regulated real-estate consultation/analysis?
Which functions must remain decision-support only and which must be disabled, relabeled, constrained, or routed through licensed professionals?
Does the product avoid implying that an automated model or unlicensed user is issuing an accredited valuation report?
If professional valuation standards are referenced, are the applicable edition, intended use, limitations, and professional-authority boundary explicit?
evidenceRequests.minimumDeliverable: Signed professional-scope review artifact mapping platform functions and claims to the applicable professional boundary, with required restrictions and VERIFIED/REJECTED/INCONCLUSIVE result.

scopeQuestions: Does the production deployment correspond exactly to the authorized release candidate, source commit, artifact SHA-256, environment reference, and environment configuration SHA-256?
Are merge execution, deployment execution, post-deployment smoke results, rollback readiness, and E2H closeout independently evidenced?
Are provider-side deployment identifiers, timestamps, logs, and immutable artifacts sufficient to establish provenance?
Is there any divergence between the qualified build and the actually deployed production runtime?
evidenceRequests.minimumDeliverable: Signed production execution-chain confirmation tied exactly to the E2H closeout packet and release identifiers, with evidence artifact SHA-256 and VERIFIED/REJECTED/INCONCLUSIVE result.

evidenceRequests.requestedVerifierRole: Independent legal/compliance reviewer of production UI, reports, marketing and contractual claims
scopeQuestions: Do all production-facing labels, reports, disclaimers, onboarding flows, marketing pages, API descriptions and contractual statements remain consistent with the approved operating mode?

Does the product avoid claiming accredited valuation, licensed real-estate consultation/analysis, brokerage, professional certification, regulatory approval, guaranteed investment outcome, or transaction authority unless separately established?
Are user-visible limitations prominent at the point of decision and in exported reports, not only in internal documentation?
Are any automated outputs likely to be mistaken for regulated professional opinions or official valuation reports?
evidenceRequests.minimumDeliverable: Signed production claims-restriction confirmation referencing the reviewed UI/report/marketing build and exact release artifact, with exceptions/remediation and VERIFIED/REJECTED/INCONCLUSIVE result.
